title: Zebra
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='26' ry='17' fill='#f4f1e8'/>
  <!-- stripes on body -->
  <path d='M30 48 Q34 60 30 72' stroke='#4a4a6a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M40 44 Q44 60 40 76' stroke='#4a4a6a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 43 Q54 60 50 77' stroke='#4a4a6a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M60 45 Q64 60 60 75' stroke='#4a4a6a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70 49 Q73 60 69 71' stroke='#4a4a6a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='32' y='72' width='8' height='16' rx='3' fill='#f4f1e8'/>
  <rect x='32' y='76' width='8' height='4' fill='#4a4a6a'/>
  <rect x='60' y='72' width='8' height='16' rx='3' fill='#f4f1e8'/>
  <rect x='60' y='76' width='8' height='4' fill='#4a4a6a'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M76 55 Q84 52 84 62' stroke='#4a4a6a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='63' r='3' fill='#4a4a6a'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <path d='M30 55 L20 34 L30 30 L38 50 Z' fill='#f4f1e8'/>
  <path d='M24 44 L32 42' stroke='#4a4a6a' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M27 36 L34 35' stroke='#4a4a6a' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='26' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#f4f1e8'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='12' cy='28' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#d8cfc0'/>
  <!-- nostril -->
  <circle cx='10' cy='28' r='1.2' fill='#4a4a6a'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <path d='M22 18 L20 10 L27 15 Z' fill='#f4f1e8'/>
  <path d='M20 12 L22 17' stroke='#4a4a6a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M31 19 L33 11 L36 18 Z' fill='#f4f1e8'/>
  <path d='M32 13 L33 18' stroke='#4a4a6a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- mane -->
  <path d='M22 17 Q20 12 24 8 Q26 14 30 16' stroke='#4a4a6a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M28 16 L34 20' stroke='#4a4a6a' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='19' cy='25' r='2' fill='#3a3a5a'/>
</svg>
